about.title: About TeamHub
about.tagline: A focused workspace for teams who want to plan work, assign tasks, and stay aligned.
about.missionDesc: TeamHub helps small and medium teams organize projects, assign tasks, and track progress in one clear, focused workspace.
about.storyDesc: TeamHub started from a simple frustration: too many tools, too much noise. We wanted one place where a team could plan work, see who owns what, and know when things are done. So we built it — a lightweight, role-aware workspace designed around the way real teams work.
about.value1Desc: We believe great products come from people who communicate, support each other, and build together.
about.value2Desc: We keep the product simple and purposeful, so teams can spend their time on the work that matters.
about.value3Desc: We build with care and test rigorously, because your team depends on our tools every day.
about.contactDesc: Have a question or feedback? We would love to hear from you.
